title: ഏറ്റവും ശക്തിയുള്ള ഇടി The Ultimate Underwater Fighter | Mantis Shrimp Secrets #malayalam  #science
description:
മാന്റിസ് ഷ്രിമ്പുകൾ എന്ന മാരക അടിക്കാർ.
This comprehensive 30-minute YouTube documentary script and research guide explores the fascinating and lethal world of the Peacock Mantis Shrimp (Odontodactylus scyllarus) and other extraordinary crustaceans.
Key Topics Covered:

The Ultimate Punch & Biomechanics: 
How the Smasher mantis shrimp uses a biological saddle spring and latch mechanism to strike at 83 km/h with a staggering 10,400g acceleration and 1,500 Newtons of force.

The Cavitation Phenomenon: 
The physics behind the vacuum bubble that collapses to temperatures reaching up to 4,000°C–5,000°C, producing a lethal hydrodynamic shockwave (dubbed the "Thumb Splitter").

Superhuman Vision: 
Why mantis shrimp possess 12 to 16 color photoreceptors, capable of seeing ultraviolet, infrared, and circular polarized light with direct eye-processing.

The Phononic Shield: 
The multi-layered Bouligand and herringbone micro-structure that protects the shrimp's own claws from shattering during impact.
